d: At Rotana, we are passionate about creating memorable experiences through genuine hospitality, exceptional service and distinctive dining experiences.

We are looking for an accomplished Director of Food & Beverage to join the leadership team at Saadiyat Island Rotana Resort & Villas, our five-star luxury beach resort located on Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi. The resort features 327 rooms, suites and 13 private beach villas, supported by an extensive food and beverage operation catering to luxury leisure, families, events and destination dining.

The resort's diverse F&B offering includes Si Ristorante Italiano & Bar, Turtle Bay Bar & Grill, The Roof Bar, Hamilton’s Gastropub, Sim Sim, Nasma Beachfront Bar and Sama Lobby Lounge, complemented by The Pool Avenue and 24-hour in-room dining.
As Director of Food & Beverage, you will lead the overall F&B operation, drive commercial performance, elevate the dining experience and develop a strong service culture across the resort.
q: li
Degree or diploma in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management or a related field.
li
Significant progressive experience in Food & Beverage leadership, including experience in a Director of Food & Beverage or comparable senior F&B leadership role.
li
Strong luxury hotel or resort experience with responsibility for multiple restaurants, bars and high-volume F&B operations.
li
Demonstrated commercial understanding of F&B revenue, profitability, budgeting, forecasting and cost control.
li
Strong knowledge of current restaurant, bar, beverage and luxury dining trends.
li
Excellent leadership skills with a proven ability to develop and inspire large, diverse F&B teams.
li
Strong guest focus with a hands-on and visible leadership approach.
li
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and decision-making skills.
li
Luxury resort and UAE/GCC experience would be a strong advantage.
p

If you are a passionate F&B leader who combines commercial thinking with creativity, operational excellence and a genuine commitment to exceptional dining experiences, we would be delighted to hear from you.
r: li
Lead the overall Food & Beverage operation across restaurants, bars, lounges, in-room dining, pool and beachfront operations.
li
Drive F&B revenue, profitability and cost effectiveness while maintaining exceptional service and product standards.
li
Develop innovative dining concepts, promotions and experiences that strengthen the resort's positioning as a leading destination on Saadiyat Island.
li
Work closely with the Executive Chef to ensure consistency between culinary quality and the overall guest dining experience.
li
Lead, coach and develop F&B leaders and colleagues, building a strong performance and service culture.
li
Monitor guest feedback, market trends and competitor activity to continuously evolve the resort's F&B offering.
li
Ensure each outlet consistently meets Rotana's operational, cleanliness, presentation and guest-readiness standards.
li
Maintain high standards of food safety, hygiene, licensing and operational compliance.
li

Work collaboratively with Sales, Marketing and Events teams to maximise opportunities across weddings, social events, corporate retreats and other resort business. The property includes two principal ballrooms, several flexible meeting spaces and a large outdoor event lawn.
li
Contribute as a senior member of the hotel leadership team to the overall commercial and operational success of the resort.

d: We’re hiring an analyst to open first conversations with investors who are new to Pairs, and to book their meetings with the founders we work with.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

You help grow the investor side of Pairs. From your first week you’re on calls with investors who are new to Pairs, learning what they invest in and why, and matching them with founders who fit. Family offices and private wealth are the investors we most want more of, and VCs are still a big part of what we do. Pairs has made more than 3,500 investor introductions for founders since we started. You don’t need a network of US startup investors to start; we bring the investors to you and coach you on building relationships with them. Software and AI run the admin, so the role isn’t technical and your time goes to people. Analysts who do well here move up to associate and run their own book of investors.
q: li
Have worked a job or an internship where you spoke to investors or senior clients yourself, for example at an expert network, consultancy, bank, wealth manager or fund.
li
Have built relationships yourself and became someone’s go-to contact, even if the first introduction came through your employer.
li
Have found your own way to a first conversation, through alumni, former colleagues or your own outreach.
li
Can research a company or an investor quickly and turn it into a clear, short briefing.
li
Use AI tools every day to speed up research and repetitive work, while keeping the relationship side human.
li
Communicate clearly and with confidence, on calls and in writing.
li
Build trust by listening first and respecting an investor’s time.
li
Handle confidential deal and investor information with care.
li
Have hit a target that was yours alone, at work or in something you started.
r: li
First conversations every week with investors who are new to Pairs.
li
Qualifying each investor: what they invest in, at what stage, and how much.
li
Booking meetings between our founders and the investors who fit them.
li
Keeping your growing list of investor relationships warm, with the goal of building your own book.
li
Support for our associates and senior team on live deals, which means researching investors, writing briefing notes before a meeting and following up after it.
x: OTE of $80,000 to $120,000 USD, base plus commission.

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time. The team works across London, New York, Dubai and San Francisco. You get the best AI tools, paid for, a senior team that coaches you every week, live deal flow from your first week and a clear path to becoming an associate.

Apply through our short form. Tell us about the investor or client relationships you’ve built so far, how you built them, and why you want a career in private capital. If you mention investors, describe them by type and leave their names out.
Role Level: Entry-Level Work Type: Full-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: https://www.pairs.ai/ Job Function: Finance Company Industry/

d: Would you like to be part of the most international company in the world? A company operating in more than 220 countries worldwide and has been pioneering cross-border express shipping since 1969. Would you like to be part of a business that connects people across the globe and want to make a difference? Then waste no time and join our amazing team at DHL Group. DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) is the Group's air, ocean, and road freight specialist. We offer standardized transport as well as highly specialized end-to-end solutions to customers in a wide range of industries globally.
Who ever said ‘‘the sky is the limit’’ never spoke to you! Because for you it’s the beginning DHL Global Forwarding has an opening for Key Account Operations Specialist in Manama, Bahrain.

Key Account Operations specialist is responsible for the end to end operational management of assigned key accounts, ensuring shipments are executed accurately, proactively, and in line with agreed customer requirements. The role acts as the main operational contact between customers, internal teams, overseas offices, carriers, customs brokers, and other service providers. A key focus is to identify risks early, resolve exceptions quickly, maintain strong operational KPIs, and continuously improve service quality.
Join us in connecting people and improving lives!
In this Key Account Operations Specialist position
Manage day to day Airfreight shipments for assigned key accounts.
Coordinate bookings, documentation, customs clearance, transportation, and delivery activities.
Ensure shipments are executed according to customer SOPs, agreed routing, cut off times, and service requirements.
Maintain ownership of shipments from booking through final delivery and file closure.
Coordinate closely with overseas offices, gateways, carriers, and local operational teams.
Act as the primary operational contact for assigned customers.
Provide timely and accurate shipment status updates.
Proactively inform customers of delays, operational risks, or service disruptions.
Provide solutions and alternative routing options where required.
Maintain professional communication and build strong working relationships with customer operational teams.
Identify potential shipment issues before they become customer escalations.
Take immediate corrective action for delays, space constraints, documentation issues, customs problems, or delivery failures.
Escalate critical issues internally when additional support is required.
Perform root-cause analysis for recurring operational failures and implement preventive actions.
Monitor customer-specific and internal operational KPIs.
Monitor billing readiness, file completion, cost accuracy, and operational exceptions.
Review recurring service failures and develop improvement actions.
q: li
Min 3 years of experience in freight forwarding, logistics, or key account operations preferred.
li
Strong operational knowledge of Air Freight and/or Ocean Freight (preferably).
li
Experience handling strategic or demanding customer accounts.
li
Understanding of freight documentation, customs processes, carrier coordination, and shipment milestones.
li
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Teams, and logistics/transport management systems.
li
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
